recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is in the core combined branch. Future edits to the patient-proficiency extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack; a Patient.communication comment that explicitly names the extension should be handled as a separate PA wording decision if desired.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration request asked for guidance on representing language communication proficiency and was resolved by adding a standard complex extension on Patient.communication with proficiency level and type Coding slices bound, preferred, to v3-LanguageAbilityProficiency and v3-LanguageAbilityMode.
initial_application: Core git commit 6f36cce95741a223e08061e1c2c19db0e5fdf3b9 applied the tracker by adding proficiency extension rows and bindings to source/patient/patient-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, which later generated source/patient/structuredefinition-extension-patient-proficiency.xml.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from R5 source, including the patient-proficiency extension. The current canonical definition exists in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-patient-proficiency.xml with the same URL, Patient.communication context, level/type slices, and requested bindings. Current core source/fhir.ini has no active Patient-specific extension source entry. Later related PA decisions reused the same extension for Practitioner communication and added a Practitioner-specific comment, but they do not change the original Patient.communication extension request.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current core checkout is correct for this reconcile run because it no longer owns the extension definition and the requested content is present in the Extension Pack source of truth.
